body:
Functionality: a project that installed Garura before #807 keeps the old names in its product model (`functionalities:`, `functionality_refs`, `functionality.md`, `functionalities/`). After #807 the scripts read only the new names, so they read that model as empty, with no error (found in the PR #810 review, P3). Only Garura's own model was moved in #807.

## Done when
- An install or upgrade of Garura into a project moves that project's product model to the new names (spine keys, refs, folders, page files and H1s), in one commit, and reports what it moved.
- A script that reads the model stops with a clear error when it finds an old key, naming the upgrade step, instead of reading an empty list.
- Tested on a copy of a pre-#807 model.

## Not in this issue
- The epics list and the slice fields (#795, #799, #801, #803).

## Links
- Serves: #788
- Part of: #792
- Found in: #807 (PR #810)
title: Upgrading Garura moves a project's product model to the Feature names, and scripts stop on old keys
